validation.method: physical USB/PTP write, read-back, and captured-value restore
validation.scope: A disposable C slot; the previously active slot and every captured property were restored after each test.

properties.verifiedValues: Printable ASCII, up to 31 UTF-16 code units
properties.notes: Unicode names remain blocked until separately verified.

properties.verifiedValues: All camera-supported non-Auto Film Simulations: PROVIA, Velvia, ASTIA, PRO Neg. Hi/Std, Monochrome (+Ye/+R/+G), Sepia, Classic Chrome, ACROS (+Ye/+R/+G), ETERNA, Classic Negative, ETERNA Bleach Bypass, Nostalgic Negative, REALA ACE
properties.notes: The original eight and the remaining twelve non-Auto values passed independent C4 write/read-back/captured-value restore tests on 2026-09-02. Film Simulation Auto remains locked because Custom Preset semantics were not tested.
Auto (FFFF) passed C4 write/read-back/captured-value restore on 2026-09-02. Camera ISO constraints still apply to fixed DR values.
Off retains grain size; restore establishes the retained size before writing Off.

properties.verifiedValues: White Priority, Auto, Ambience Priority, Daylight, Shade, Fluorescent 1/2/3, Incandescent, Underwater, Color Temperature
dependencies: Color Temperature must be written after White Balance is set to Color Temperature.
properties.notes: White Priority (8020) and Ambience Priority (8021) passed C4 write/read-back/captured-value restore on 2026-09-02. Custom 1–3 remain locked because their C-slot mapping and recovery semantics are unverified.

properties.verifiedValues: 2500 K, 6500 K, 10000 K; encoder permits 2500–10000 K in 10 K steps
dependencies: White Balance must be Color Temperature (D199 = 8007) before this property is written.
properties.notes: The app does not write this field under any other White Balance mode.

properties.notes: S 3:2 (01 00), S 16:9 (02 00), S 1:1 (03 00), M 3:2 (04 00), M 16:9 (05 00), M 1:1 (06 00), L 16:9 (08 00), and L 1:1 (09 00) each passed write/read-back/captured-value restore on C4 on 2026-09-02.
